{{Quote|Commander Fox, the prisoner!|The trooper alerts Fox|<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref>}}
A '''clone''' served as a [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] with [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. He was stationed at the [[Republic military base]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
The trooper along with [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|Fox]] escorted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond's]] cell, who was being held for the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|attack]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Leaving Tano with Turmond, the shock troopers returned to the guard post. Meanwhile Turmond revealed that a Jedi had showed her how to make the bomb in an effort to make a statement against the Jedi being involved in the war. Before Turmond could give Tano the name, Turmond was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking_powers|Force-choked]], unknown to all, by Jedi [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]. However, the view from the security cameras made it appears as if Tano was the one choking Turmond. The trooper notified Fox of Turmond's distress. They quickly rushed into the cell, only to find Tano, apparently distraught, bending over Turmond's dead body. Fox, while not blaming Tano for wanting revenge on a traitor, placed her under arrest.
